header: Getting started with the OpenSearch user interface in Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
OpenSearch Service
In Amazon OpenSearch Service, an application is an instance of the OpenSearch user interface
(OpenSearch UI). Each application can be associated with multiple data sources, and a single source
can be associated with multiple applications. You can create multiple applications for diﬀerent
administrators using diﬀerent supported authentication options.
Use the information in this topic to guide you through the process of creating an OpenSearch UI
application using the AWS Management Console or the AWS CLI.
